name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: A Classic Margherita Pizza is presented on a wooden serving board, sliced into wedges with one slice slightly lifted to reveal stretchy mozzarella. The pizza features a charred, puffy crust with visible blistering, topped with vibrant red tomato sauce, melted white mozzarella cheese, and fresh green basil leaves arranged in a radial pattern. A small bowl of extra tomato sauce and a glass of olive oil accompany the dish, suggesting a rustic, authentic Italian preparation style.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The dish features chunks of grilled or charred chicken in a rich, creamy orange-red sauce, garnished with fresh cilantro leaves and a swirl of white cream. It is served in a traditional hammered copper-style bowl with brass handles, placed on a dark slate board alongside a side of steamed white rice and a folded naan bread. The portion appears generous and well-balanced, with small bowls of spices and condiments arranged in the background for accompaniment.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: A white bowl contains a vegetable stir-fry with cubed tofu, broccoli florets, sliced carrots, and snow peas, all coated in a glossy brown sauce. The dish is presented alongside a small bowl of steamed white rice and a pair of wooden chopsticks on a neutral-toned surface. The portion appears generous and well-balanced, suitable for one main course serving.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: A Greek Giouvertsa Salad is presented in a large, light-colored ceramic bowl, featuring chopped lettuce as a base topped with halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber, sliced red onion, whole kalamata olives, and crumbled feta cheese. The ingredients appear fresh and uncooked, arranged in a vibrant, colorful mound with visible black pepper seasoning, and a metal spoon rests in the bowl for serving. A small side bowl of golden lemon-oregano dressing, a lemon wedge, and fresh oregano sprigs accompany the salad on a wooden surface, suggesting a generous, family-style portion size.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: The dish features spaghetti aglio e olio served in a white bowl, with noodles twirled into a neat mound and coated in a light, glistening olive oil sauce. Visible ingredients include golden-brown sliced garlic, finely chopped fresh parsley, red pepper flakes, and a sprinkle of grated hard cheese—likely Parmesan—on top. The presentation is rustic and warm, with steam rising from the pasta, suggesting it is freshly cooked and served hot, and the portion appears generous yet balanced for one person.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: A large, seared salmon fillet with visible flaky texture and a glossy, caramelized glaze is presented on a wooden board. The dish is garnished with fresh dill sprigs, whole mustard seeds, black peppercorns, and coarse salt, with a dark amber glaze being drizzled over the top and pooling around the base. Sliced lemon wedges and a small glass bowl of extra glaze accompany the salmon, suggesting a generous, restaurant-style portion.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: A bowl of smooth, vibrant red tomato basil soup is centered in the image, garnished with fresh basil leaves, a sprinkle of black pepper, and finely chopped herbs. Surrounding the bowl are visible ingredients including whole and sliced tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, garlic cloves, a red chili pepper, sliced red onion, olive oil, coarse salt, and a small dollop of cream or yogurt. The presentation is a top-down flat-lay style with ingredients artfully arranged around the bowl, suggesting a rustic, ingredient-forward preparation; the portion appears to be a standard single serving.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: The dish features Pad Thai with stir-fried rice noodles, large cooked shrimp, scrambled egg, bean sprouts, and chopped green onions, garnished with a lime wedge. The preparation style is clearly stir-fried, evident from the glossy sauce coating the noodles and the varied textures of the ingredients. It is presented in a wide, shallow ceramic bowl on a wooden surface, surrounded by small bowls of peanuts, chili flakes, tamarind paste, garlic, and fresh limes, suggesting a generous, restaurant-style portion.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: The image displays a plate of golden-brown, round chickpea falafel balls, garnished with fresh parsley, sliced red onion, green scallions, and a lemon wedge. The falafel appear pan-fried or deep-fried, with a textured, slightly crispy surface, and are served alongside a swirl of creamy tahini sauce on the side. The dish is presented on a rustic ceramic plate with surrounding ingredients like whole chickpeas, herbs, spices, garlic cloves, and olive oil, suggesting a generous, family-style portion.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: Four beef tacos are arranged on a dark plate, filled with seasoned ground beef, shredded lettuce, shredded cheddar cheese, diced tomatoes, green salsa verde, and a dollop of white cream (likely sour cream or crema). The tacos are served in soft corn tortillas, with additional garnishes like lime wedges and chopped green bell peppers scattered around the plate. Small bowls of shredded cheese, salsa roja, and more sour cream surround the main dish, suggesting a family-style or customizable serving setup.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: A pan-seared ribeye steak with prominent grill marks and a rich brown crust rests in a dark cast-iron skillet, surrounded by rendered fat, fresh thyme sprigs, and three pats of butter. The steak is seasoned with coarse salt and cracked peppercorns, and the dish is garnished with additional herbs and scattered seasonings. The presentation is rustic and elevated, with small wooden bowls of sea salt, whole peppercorns, and olive oil arranged around the skillet, suggesting a generous, hearty portion size.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: The dish features a rich, reddish-brown lentil dal with visible whole brown lentils, garnished with fresh cilantro leaves, sliced white onion rings, a lime wedge, and halved cherry tomatoes. The preparation appears to be a simmered or cooked dal with spices visibly sprinkled on top, including cumin seeds and turmeric powder, suggesting a traditional Indian-style preparation. Served in a rustic ceramic bowl resting on a beige cloth, the portion is generous and centrally composed, with surrounding ingredients like onion, garlic, and a small bowl of turmeric powder enhancing the visual context.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: A seared miso-glazed cod fillet rests atop a bed of white sesame rice on a wide ceramic plate, drizzled with a glossy dark sauce and garnished with sliced green onions, black and white sesame seeds, and thin golden fried noodles. The fish shows distinct grill marks and a caramelized surface, indicating pan-searing or broiling with a glaze applied near the end of cooking. The dish is presented as a single-portion meal, accompanied by a small bowl of extra sauce, a side of plain rice, and scattered sesame seeds, all arranged on a neutral-toned surface with wooden utensils nearby.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: The image displays Caribbean Jerk Chicken, featuring several golden-brown, spice-coated chicken pieces—primarily drumsticks and thighs—garnished with fresh rosemary sprigs, whole black and pink peppercorns, and lime wedges on a wooden platter. The chicken appears grilled or roasted, with a glossy, caramelized glaze and visible seasoning flecks, suggesting a spicy-sweet jerk marinade. Accompanying the main dish are small clay bowls containing white rice, a reddish-orange sauce, coarse salt, and kidney beans, arranged around the platter for a rustic, abundant presentation.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The dish features penne pasta tossed with roasted cherry tomatoes—both red and yellow, halved and charred at the edges—and fresh basil leaves, garnished with grated cheese and black pepper. The preparation style is rustic and Mediterranean-inspired, with visible roasting marks on the tomatoes and a lightly sautéed or dressed pasta base. Served in a wide, earth-toned ceramic bowl with a blue glaze rim, the portion appears generous and well-composed, surrounded by scattered fresh ingredients like garlic, basil sprigs, and whole tomatoes for visual context.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image displays a bowl of Paneer Butter Masala, featuring cubed paneer in a rich, reddish-orange creamy sauce, garnished with sliced white onions and fresh cilantro. The dish is surrounded by accompaniments including steamed rice, naan bread, whole and powdered spices (turmeric, red chili), a whole onion, dried chilies, and scattered spice dust. The presentation is a top-down, styled food photograph with a generous portion size, arranged on a dark surface to highlight the vibrant colors and textures.

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: The image shows two tall, fluted glass servings of Falooda (Dessert Drink), layered with red syrup, white cream or yogurt, thin vermicelli noodles, and red jelly cubes. Visible garnishes include whipped cream, a pink rose, fresh cherries, mint leaves, and scattered rose petals and ice cubes. The presentation is elegant and abundant, with additional toppings like pink and red powdered sugar and vermicelli arranged on a slate board beside the glasses, suggesting a generous portion size.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: The image shows a pan of Shakshuka with four intact eggs nestled in a vibrant tomato-based sauce, surrounded by sliced red and green bell peppers, chopped onions, and scattered black peppercorns. The dish is presented in a rustic black skillet, placed on a parchment-like surface amid surrounding ingredients like whole garlic bulbs, fresh parsley, chili peppers, and small bowls of spices and sauces. The portion appears generous and family-sized, centered in the frame with an overhead composition highlighting its colorful, hearty arrangement.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: The image depicts a plated serving of Cuban Black Beans and Rice, featuring a central mound of white rice surrounded by a generous portion of cooked black beans. Visible ingredients include sliced onions, whole garlic cloves, bay leaves, and scattered spices, with the beans appearing simmered in a rich, dark sauce. The dish is presented on a white plate with a rustic, illustrative style, suggesting a hearty, family-style portion size.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: The image displays a plated serving of Beef Bulgogi, featuring thinly sliced marinated beef cooked to a medium-rare doneness, arranged over a bed of sliced onions and garnished with green onions, toasted sesame seeds, and scattered black and white sesame seeds. The dish is presented in a large, rustic ceramic bowl on a wooden board lined with parchment paper, surrounded by side components including steamed white rice, garlic cloves, green onions, and small bowls of red pepper flakes, sesame oil, and various seeds. The portion size appears generous and intended for sharing or as a main course, with the beef slices overlapping in a slightly fanned arrangement for visual appeal.

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The image shows a Spanish Paella Valenciana served in a large, shallow paella pan, featuring golden saffron-infused rice topped with whole chicken legs, halved cherry tomatoes, dried red chilies, and sprigs of rosemary. The dish is presented on a dark wooden surface surrounded by raw ingredients like onions, garlic, rice, olive oil, and spices, suggesting a rustic, authentic preparation style. The portion size appears generous, suitable for sharing, with the rice and chicken arranged in a circular, evenly distributed pattern across the pan.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: The image shows a steaming bowl of Tom Yum Goong, a Thai hot and sour shrimp soup, with a rich, reddish-brown broth. Visible ingredients include plump cooked shrimp, whole garlic cloves, kaffir lime leaves, sliced red chilies, fresh cilantro, a lime wedge, and a stalk of lemongrass. The soup is presented in a wide ceramic bowl with a white spoon, accompanied by a small side dish of chili sauce, suggesting a generous, restaurant-style portion.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: The dish features grilled chicken breast sliced into strips, resting atop a bed of green romaine lettuce with cherry tomatoes, golden-brown croutons, and shaved Parmesan cheese. The salad is dressed with a creamy Caesar-style dressing, lightly drizzled over the ingredients and sprinkled with black pepper and grated cheese. It is served in a dark ceramic bowl with a generous portion size, showcasing a well-balanced mix of textures and colors.

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: The image shows a baked moussaka in a rectangular metal baking dish, featuring layered sliced eggplant topped with a spiced ground meat filling and a golden-brown melted cheese or béchamel layer. The dish is garnished with small sprigs of fresh herbs and surrounded by rustic accompaniments including a bowl of yogurt with olive oil, whole tomatoes, an eggplant, and small bowls of spices and seasonings. The portion appears generous and family-sized, served directly from the baking pan on a wooden surface with a woven mat underneath.

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: The dish features wavy ramen noodles submerged in a dark shoyu-based broth, topped with sliced grilled chicken breast, two halves of a soft-boiled egg with runny yolks, chopped green onions, and julienned white radish. The presentation is artfully arranged in a rustic dark ceramic bowl, with a small side cup of additional broth and scattered black pepper and sesame seeds for garnish. The portion appears generous and well-balanced, suitable for a single serving.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: The dish features wide, yellow pasta noodles tossed with plump, pinkish-orange lemon garlic shrimp, green beans, and scattered black pepper, garnished with lemon wedges and fresh herbs. The shrimp appear sautéed or stir-fried, with a glossy sheen suggesting a light sauce, and the surrounding elements—whole lemons, garlic bulbs, salt, and peppercorns—emphasize the fresh, zesty preparation style. Served in a shallow, earth-toned ceramic bowl on a textured cloth, the portion is generous and well-arranged, with shrimp distributed evenly across the pasta for visual balance.

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: The image displays a vibrant, colorful ratatouille composed of sliced zucchini, eggplant, tomatoes, red and yellow bell peppers, and onions, all arranged in a white bowl with visible herbs and spices. The vegetables appear lightly cooked or sautéed, retaining their shape and bright colors, suggesting a gentle preparation method typical of the dish. The presentation is abundant and artfully arranged on a wooden board, surrounded by whole ingredients and seasonings, indicating a generous, family-style portion size.

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: The dish features two seared salmon fillets with visibly crispy, golden-brown skin and flaky orange-pink flesh, seasoned with cracked black pepper and white peppercorns, and garnished with fresh dill. The salmon rests on a rustic ceramic plate alongside lemon wedges and a small bowl of dill yogurt sauce—creamy white with finely chopped dill and a sprinkle of reddish spice—accompanied by additional dill sprigs and a side of plain yogurt and whole peppercorns. The presentation is artfully arranged in a top-down, styled food photograph, suggesting a generous, restaurant-quality portion suitable for one person.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: The dish features Thai green curry with tofu cubes, zucchini slices, snow peas, bell peppers (green, yellow, red), and sliced chilies, all simmered in a vibrant green sauce and served alongside a portion of white rice. The plating is artfully arranged with scattered fresh basil leaves, whole green peas, a green bell pepper, and small bowls of chili oil and cream-based condiment surrounding the main bowl, suggesting a generous, restaurant-style serving.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: The image displays a vibrant, illustrated serving of Mango Sticky Rice, featuring cubed ripe mango arranged on a blue plate alongside a bowl of glutinous rice topped with a glossy mango sauce and diced fruit, garnished with fresh basil leaves. The portion size is visually substantial, presented as a single hearty serving suitable for one person, with additional mango slices and scattered leaves enhancing the plating.

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: The Herbed Quinoa Salad is presented in a shallow ceramic bowl, featuring cooked quinoa mixed with sliced cucumbers, halved red and yellow cherry tomatoes, and scattered fresh parsley leaves. The salad appears lightly dressed, with visible black and white peppercorns and a sprinkle of herbs, suggesting a fresh, uncooked preparation style. The portion is generous and evenly distributed in the bowl, surrounded by garnishes including lemon wedges, a small dish of olive oil, and scattered peppercorns and herbs on the dark surface.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: The Beef Shawarma Wrap features tender, seasoned diced beef layered with fresh lettuce, sliced cucumber, tomato, and red onion inside a lightly toasted flatbread, tied with twine. The wrap is presented on a dark slate board, surrounded by small bowls of tahini, yogurt-based sauce, spiced oil, and mixed peppercorns, with additional garnishes like sliced tomatoes and red chilies nearby. The portion appears generous and well-stacked, suggesting a hearty, ready-to-eat serving.

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: The Pesto Chicken Bake is presented in a rectangular ceramic baking dish, featuring golden-brown seared chicken breasts arranged over a bed of spaghetti, melted white cheese, and vibrant green pesto sauce. Roasted cherry tomatoes are scattered throughout the dish, with additional pesto visible in a wooden spoon beside the dish. The portion appears generous, suitable for 4–6 servings, with the ingredients layered and baked to create a cohesive, rustic casserole-style presentation.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: The image shows a baked eggplant parmesan in a rectangular metal baking dish, featuring stacked slices of eggplant layered with red tomato sauce, melted cheese, and golden-brown breadcrumbs. The dish is garnished with freshly grated Parmesan cheese and herbs, presented on a dark wooden surface surrounded by ingredients like whole tomatoes, garlic, onions, and bowls of sauce and cheese. The portion size appears substantial, suitable for serving multiple people, with the dish filling the entire baking pan.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: A bowl of Moroccan Chickpea Stew features whole chickpeas simmered in a rich, reddish-orange sauce, topped with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro leaves. The stew is presented in a rustic ceramic bowl with decorative patterns, accompanied by a spoon, scattered chickpeas, whole tomatoes, olive oil, and small bowls of spices and herbs on a wooden tray. The portion appears generous and hearty, suitable for a main course serving.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: The image displays a prepared Crunchy Cabbage Slaw in a large, rustic ceramic bowl, featuring shredded green cabbage and julienned orange carrots, lightly dressed with a creamy white sauce. Surrounding the main dish are small bowls and containers holding measured ingredients including mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt, and oil, suggesting a composed, recipe-style presentation on a wooden cutting board. The portion appears generous and serves as a full side or salad serving, with visible garnishes and utensils enhancing the staged, instructional aesthetic.

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: The dish is a vibrant Ceviche de Pescado served in a rustic ceramic bowl, featuring cubed white fish marinated in citrus (evidenced by lime wedges and juice), garnished with sliced red onion, halved red chili peppers, fresh cilantro leaves, and black pepper. The portion appears generous, filling the wide, shallow bowl and surrounded by whole chilies, limes, and herbs on a wooden surface, suggesting a hearty serving for one or two people.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: The dish features stir-fried chicken pieces mixed with fresh Thai basil leaves, sliced red chilies, and black peppercorns, served alongside a mound of white rice on a patterned ceramic plate. The ingredients appear lightly sautéed in a dark soy-based sauce, with visible garlic cloves, whole chilies, and scattered peppercorns arranged around the plate as garnish. The portion is generous and well-balanced, with the chicken and basil mixture occupying the lower half of the plate and the rice centered above, suggesting a hearty, authentic serving size.

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: The dish features a classic Caprese Salad with alternating slices of ripe red tomato, fresh white mozzarella, and vibrant green basil leaves, arranged in a circular pattern on a white ceramic plate. The salad is dressed with a drizzle of dark balsamic glaze and a light olive oil sheen, with visible black pepper and coarse salt sprinkled across the top. It is presented as a single-portion appetizer, garnished with scattered basil leaves and accompanied by a small side bowl of balsamic reduction, set atop a wooden board with a linen napkin and fork nearby.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The image shows a pan of pumpkin risotto, with creamy, cooked rice topped with a vibrant orange pumpkin puree and diced pumpkin cubes. Visible garnishes include sliced red onions, a pat of butter, olive oil, salt, pepper, and fresh herbs, arranged in distinct sections within the pan. The dish is presented in a rustic, overhead style on a textured cloth, surrounded by whole and halved pumpkins, shallots, garlic, and small bowls of ingredients, suggesting a generous, hearty portion size.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: The dish features Garlic Butter Shrimp served in a dark skillet, with plump, pink-and-white shrimp nestled in a golden garlic butter sauce, garnished with chopped parsley and whole and sliced garlic cloves. The preparation style appears sautéed or pan-seared, with visible garlic cloves and herbs distributed throughout the sauce. The portion is generous and centered on a wooden board, surrounded by fresh lemon wedges, whole garlic bulbs, and small bowls of olive oil and seasoned butter, suggesting a rustic, appetizer-sized serving.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 1 tablespoon cornstarch mixed with 1 tablespoon water
directions: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken until cooked through; remove and set aside.
In the same wok, sauté garlic, ginger, and dried chilies until fragrant.
Return chicken to the wok, add the peanuts and the sauce mixture.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve hot with steamed rice.
image_description: The image displays a vibrant, stir-fried Kung Pao Chicken dish in a large black wok, featuring cubed chicken pieces coated in a glossy, reddish-brown sauce, mixed with whole dried red chilies, sliced onions, and scattered peanuts. name: Mapo Tofu
directions: Brown the ground meat in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the spicy bean paste and peppercorns, stirring until fragrant and the oil turns red.
Pour in the chicken broth and soy sauce; bring to a simmer.
Gently add the tofu cubes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve.
image_description: The image shows a serving of Mapo Tofu in a large, dark wok-style pan, featuring cubed soft tofu, minced pork, and a rich, reddish-brown spicy sauce with visible chili oil and Sichuan peppercorns. name: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 300g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
directions: Toss beef slices with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce; let sit for 10 minutes.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok and sear beef at high heat until browned; remove.
Stir-fry ginger for 30 seconds, then add broccoli, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Return beef to the wok and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.

name: General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Coat chicken pieces thoroughly in cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken in hot oil until crispy and golden; drain on paper towels.
In a separate pan, sauté ginger, garlic, and chilies.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the crispy chicken into the sauce until fully coated.
Serve over white rice.
image_description: The dish features General Tso’s Chicken served in a rustic brown bowl, with golden-brown, crispy chicken pieces coated in a glossy, reddish-brown sweet-and-savory sauce, accompanied by a mound of white steamed rice. name: Pork Potstickers (Dumplings)
directions: Mix pork, cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of a wrapper, moisten edges, and fold/pleat to seal.
Heat oil in a flat skillet and arrange dumplings in a single layer.
Fry for 2 minutes until bottoms are golden.
Pour in water and immediately cover with a lid to steam for 5-7 minutes.
Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
directions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add tofu, bamboo shoots, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten egg while stirring gently to create ribbons.
Stir in the rice vinegar at the very end to preserve the 'sour' punch.
Garnish with green onions.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant, illustrated serving of Hot and Sour Soup in a black dual-handled pot, featuring visible ingredients including cubed tofu, noodles, a whole poached egg, chopped green onions, bamboo shoots, and rice starch slurry. The portion appears generous and communal, presented alongside neatly arranged ingredient components like lagg egg, rose sauce, sugar, and scallions on a clean white surface.

name: Chow Mein
directions: Boil noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry cabbage and carrots for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the wok.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then pour over the noodles.
Toss at high heat for 2-3 minutes until noodles are slightly charred and well coated.
Serve hot.
image_description: The dish features stir-fried chow mein noodles mixed with colorful vegetables including broccoli florets, sliced carrots, bok choy, green beans, and cabbage, all coated in a glossy brown sauce. name: Wonton Soup
directions: Bring chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the wontons and simmer for 5 minutes (or until they float).
Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Turn off heat and stir in sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
directions: Dip shrimp in egg, then coat with cornstarch.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey, and condensed milk.
Toss the warm shrimp and candied walnuts into the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately, usually garnished with steamed broccoli.
